text: The CRP delivered eight projects on time, with the RRBTP covering 1,600 km of berms. Early outcomes indicated improved berm conditions and positive ecological impacts, though comprehensive quantitative performance data remain limited. The programme advanced mahinga kai opportunities, fish passage access, and recreational upgrades, contributing to long-term ecological resilience.
